The '''Kimanan system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Orus sector/Legends|Orus sector]] of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] and contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kimanan]].
